observation: 'agent-loop finish <task> --learning findings_recorded' cannot be completed through the finish front door at all. It requires at least one finding id, its own command_template omits the option, and passing the option that 'agent-loop workflow learn' documents fails with '[FAIL] finish: Unknown option: --finding'. The transition only succeeds through the lower-level 'agent-loop workflow learn <task> --status findings_recorded --by ... --reason ... --finding <id> ...'.

evidence.summary: agent-loop finish VPR-1 --learning findings_recorded --learning-reason ... --by ... -> [FAIL] findings_recorded requires at least one finding id. Adding --finding <id> -> [FAIL] finish: Unknown option: --finding. agent-loop workflow learn VPR-1 --status findings_recorded --by ... --reason ... --finding <id> ... -> [OK].

hypothesis: finish forwards a fixed subset of options to the learning transition and was never exercised with the findings_recorded status, only with no_durable_learning, which needs no finding ids.
validated_conclusion: finish has to accept and forward --finding, or its command_template for findings_recorded has to name 'workflow learn' as the command to run. As it stands the documented front door dead-ends on the only status that carries durable findings, and the JSON contract hides the refusal.
